newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General posts big H1 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General posts big H1 profit rise.

text.p: British insurance company Legal & General Plc on Thursday posted a larger-than-expected rise in operating profit to 134.3 million pounds after 111.1 million in the first half of last year.
The insurer also weighed in with a 13.6 percent rise in its interim dividend which rose to 8.75p per share compared to 7.7p last time.
Legal & General chief executive David Prosser said the results had been achieved in a market which remains highly competitive.
"The strong increase in new business, especially in life and pensions income, enhances the group's future profit potential," Prosser said in a statement.
The company's pre-tax profit figure was inflated to 1.51 billion pounds compared with 119.1 million last time by changes in the way results are reported required by a European Union directive.
The figure for the first half of this year includes 1.402 billion pounds reclassified from its shareholders' retained capital within its UK long-term fund.
